en.name: AKS-74U SAG MK3 handguard (Black)
en.description: The Sureshot Armament MK3 handguard made for the AKS-74U. The chassis system is split into two pieces, the handguard and dust cover, so that the end user does not need to disassemble their entire weapon to service it. Comes in every color of the kalashnikov rainbow.
